a10.hut.text: Stone by stone. My back will remember this.

a10.sign.text: Hajurama's Pasal, Mountain Branch. It has a ring to it!

a10.fences.text: A yak sat on my toolbox. A YAK.

a10.bench.text: Rest your legs, have a Lapsi candy!

a10.lamp.text: Solar powered! Even I'm impressed with me.

a10.crates.text: So many candies! For the shop. Not for me. Mostly.

a10.pots.text: Even up here, flowers find a way.

a10.umbrella.text: I came all this way for tea under an umbrella!

a10.bunting.text: Look how it flutters in the wind!

a10.arrive.text: The mountains look so close you could touch them.
Maya... the shop is a pile of stones. Literally.
Then we have a lot of stones to work with!

a10.outro.text: Three shops. A whole family of pasals.
From one dusty counter to the mountains. I am so proud of you, nani.
And Chiya Tole has the best tea AND the best sweets.
One jar at a time, Bhai. One jar at a time.
